title: [B00] Bootstrap a repeatable extension
body:
<!-- piarre-backlog:B00:v0.2 -->

## Outcome

A contributor can install, lint, test, package, and launch the VS Code extension from documented commands.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] CI runs the same lint, test, and package commands as local development.
- [ ] A fresh checkout launches the extension development host.
- [ ] No A00 workflow or spike source is part of the product branch.

## Required evidence

- CI run
- extension smoke test

title: [B01] Open a durable Piarre project
body:
<!-- piarre-backlog:B01:v0.2 -->

## Outcome

Opening a trusted repository creates or replays a durable Piarre project and shows its Work view.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The event log is authoritative and the project snapshot is a projection.
- [ ] Duplicate command IDs do not duplicate effects.
- [ ] Every state-changing command rejects a stale project revision.
- [ ] Restart reproduces the same observable project state.

## Required evidence

- restart integration test
- idempotency test
- stale-revision test

- [ ] No workspace write occurs before visual approval.

title: [B03] Run one bounded coding task
body:
<!-- piarre-backlog:B03:v0.2 -->

## Outcome

An approved task runs through one capability-driven worker contract while a second writer remains blocked.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The adapter reports observed capabilities instead of relying on provider names.
- [ ] Start, observe, steer when supported, interrupt, and inspect share one behavior contract.
- [ ] Workspace and approved-command scopes are enforced.
- [ ] A deterministic mock worker and the first real adapter pass the same contract.

## Required evidence

- worker contract suite
- single-writer integration test
- current live-adapter evidence

body:

- [ ] Required current checks are necessary for Needs review.
- [ ] Worker completion text cannot accept a task.

title: [B06] Stop without pretending to roll back
body:
<!-- piarre-backlog:B06:v0.2 -->

## Outcome

Stopping work preserves partial changes and reports uncertainty until the worker and disk are reconciled.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Stop task requests interruption and inspects actual worker and workspace state.
- [ ] Owned processes are reconciled.
- [ ] Repeated stop requests converge on one result.
- [ ] The UI never labels an unobserved run as stopped.

## Required evidence

- interrupt integration test
- idempotent-stop test
- partial-change fixture

title: [B07] Recover after restart
body:
<!-- piarre-backlog:B07:v0.2 -->

## Outcome

Restart restores durable work without repeating external actions or inventing a final run state.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Running, interrupted, and Needs review states replay correctly.
- [ ] Active external runs become unknown until inspected.
- [ ] Workspace and worker observations are appended before scheduling resumes.
- [ ] A lost acknowledgement does not repeat an external action.

## Required evidence

- crash-restart scenarios
- exactly-once effect fixture

- [ ] Measured usage and estimates use separate labels.

- [ ] Exports omit secrets.
- [ ] Local deletion is read back and verified without claiming provider-side deletion.
